image.subject: A stocky white-haired man in his sixties, warm and direct, wearing a plain open-collar shirt and a sport jacket, sits at the head of a long conference table in a glass-walled Silicon Valley office, leaning forward with his hands clasped while two young men across from him listen, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: A former college football coach sits with the most powerful founders in tech.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Bill Campbell at the head of a conference table, two founders listening across from him.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Opening scene.
storyboard.addedInformation: Who is in the room: a coach, not a tech executive.

image.subject: An empty tech company boardroom with a wooden table, leather chairs and a projector screen on the wall, late afternoon light through the windows, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: These rooms hold billions of dollars of stakes.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The empty boardroom, the table waiting for the meeting.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Sets the room the coach walks into.
storyboard.addedInformation: The setting is a boardroom, not a classroom.

image.subject: Two young men in open shirts sit stiffly at a conference table in a glass-walled office, arms folded, a laptop closed between them, the air heavy with a standoff before a product ships, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: The product is about to ship and the tension is high.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two founders at a table, arms folded, not speaking.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the room to the people in it.
storyboard.addedInformation: The founders are shown as tense, not as products.

image.subject: A stocky white-haired man in his sixties, warm and direct, wearing a plain open-collar shirt and a sport jacket, sits at a conference table turned toward two young men, a closed laptop and a stack of papers pushed aside in front of him, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: The coach asks nothing about the software.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The coach at the table, laptop pushed aside, turned to the engineers.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The coach is at the head of the table.
storyboard.addedInformation: He sets the laptop aside to focus on the people.

storyboard.claim: He asks about their people.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only: the question he asks.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the scene of the pushed-aside laptop.
storyboard.addedInformation: The question is the coach's real opening move.

image.subject: A man in his fifties with short graying hair and a dark blazer over an open-collar shirt, measured and attentive, sits across a desk with a notebook open, listening carefully, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: People are the central argument of the whole book.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A measured, attentive man at a desk with a notebook.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The question about people leads into the argument.
storyboard.addedInformation: The argument is framed by the authors' own point of view.

image.subject: A stocky white-haired man in his sixties, warm and direct, wearing a plain open-collar shirt and a sport jacket, stands alone in a dim corridor of a Silicon Valley office, backlit by a glass wall, the posture of a football coach, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: Campbell is remembered as a shadowy legend.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Campbell alone in a dim corridor, backlit.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The argument now turns to his reputation.
storyboard.addedInformation: The legend is pictured as a man in a corridor, not a myth.

image.subject: A stocky white-haired man in his sixties, warm and direct, wearing a plain open-collar shirt and a sport jacket, sits beside a whiteboard covered in a team diagram, his hand on the marker, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: The legend is a misunderstanding: he was not a mentor of talent.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Campbell beside a whiteboard, marker in hand.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Corrects the legend just described.
storyboard.addedInformation: He worked on teams, drawn on a whiteboard.

image.subject: A slim man in his forties with a black mock turtleneck, jeans and sneakers, intense focused gaze, leans over a desk looking at a prototype phone, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: He did not teach Steve Jobs to design a phone.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jobs leaning over a prototype phone on a desk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Gives a concrete example of what the coach did not teach.
storyboard.addedInformation: Jobs is shown with the product he cares about.

image.subject: A group of engineers and managers gather around a whiteboard in a bright startup office, one of them drawing a team chart, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: He was a builder of teams.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A team gathered around a whiteboard drawing a team chart.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Replaces the product idea with a team.
storyboard.addedInformation: The product he built is a team.

image.subject: A team of engineers sits around a long conference table in a glass-walled office, facing each other mid-conversation, a whiteboard behind them, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: His product was the trust between founders and managers.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Team members in mid-conversation around a long table.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Builds on the team idea.
storyboard.addedInformation: Trust is shown as the working relationship at the table.

image.subject: A stack of hardcover business books on a glass desk in a Silicon Valley office, a coffee cup beside them, morning light, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: This is not a biography of a legend.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Business books on a desk, unopened.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: The argument shifts to the purpose of the video.
storyboard.addedInformation: The purpose is a working manual, not a portrait.

image.subject: A woman in her thirties with shoulder-length brown hair and a cardigan, sitting across a desk from a colleague, listening, a notebook on the desk between them, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: The playbook is for you, the reader on your commute or at your desk.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A manager at a desk across from a colleague.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Turns from the book to the viewer.
storyboard.addedInformation: The viewer is pictured as the manager across the desk.

image.subject: A spiral-bound working notebook open on a desk beside a laptop, pages filled with handwritten notes and a pen resting across them, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: The episode treats this as an operational manual.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An open working notebook with handwritten notes.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the viewer picture.
storyboard.addedInformation: The manual is handwritten notes from working sessions.

image.subject: A stocky white-haired man in his sixties, warm and direct, wearing a plain open-collar shirt and a sport jacket, writing in a notebook at a desk in a plain office, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: To understand the playbook you must understand the man who wrote it.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Campbell writing in a notebook at a desk.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves from the manual to its author.
storyboard.addedInformation: The author is shown writing notes.

image.subject: A stocky white-haired man in his sixties, warm and direct, wearing a plain open-collar shirt and a sport jacket, stands in a Silicon Valley office with his arms crossed, smiling slightly, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: Who Bill Campbell was explains why the founders listen to him.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Campbell standing with arms crossed in an office.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Introduces the man by name.
storyboard.addedInformation: He is a warm, direct presence, not a mythic figure.

image.subject: A slim man in his forties with a black mock turtleneck, jeans and sneakers, intense focused gaze, sits across a table from a stocky white-haired man in a sport jacket, the two in a tense but attentive conversation, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: Unmanageable founders still listen to him.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jobs and Campbell in a focused conversation at a table.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains the previous claim with a scene.
storyboard.addedInformation: Jobs is shown listening, not dominating.

storyboard.claim: He is a scrappy, undersized kid from the steel town of Homestead.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only: the town name.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Starts his background.
storyboard.addedInformation: The town is a western Pennsylvania steel town.

image.subject: Two rows of young computer scientists at monitors in a university lab, one of them lit by a monitor glow, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: Elite PhD computer scientists sit on one side of the contrast.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A university lab of computer scientists at monitors.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Sets up the contrast with Campbell.
storyboard.addedInformation: The elite side is the academic lab.

image.subject: A 1960s steel mill at dusk in a small Pennsylvania town, smokestacks glowing, a tired worker in a work jacket walking home past it, circa 1960

storyboard.claim: His father taught physical education and worked at the steel mill.
storyboard.concreteVisual: The steel mill at dusk with a worker walking home.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Contrasts the PhDs with his upbringing.
storyboard.addedInformation: The father worked at the mill to make ends meet.

storyboard.claim: He was about five foot ten and 165 pounds, undersized for football.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only: the body measurements.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Describes his build after the upbringing.
storyboard.addedInformation: His size is the physical fact the story sets up.

image.subject: A small college football player in a leather helmet and jersey jogs to the sideline past bigger teammates on a 1960s field under a gray sky, circa 1960

storyboard.claim: Against physical odds he became the football captain at Columbia.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A small player in a leather helmet jogging past bigger teammates.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the undersized stat.
storyboard.addedInformation: The captaincy is shown as earned by a small player.

image.subject: A 1960s college football linebacker in a leather helmet and mud-streaked jersey crouches in the line of scrimmage on a rain-soaked field, circa 1960

storyboard.claim: He played almost every minute as a linebacker and guard.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A linebacker crouched in the line on a wet field.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Adds the physical punishment of the position.
storyboard.addedInformation: He played linebacker and guard.

storyboard.claim: He helped lead Columbia to its only Ivy League title in 1961.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only: the year and title.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the football career.
storyboard.addedInformation: The Columbia title is the only Ivy League title the team won.

image.subject: A stocky white-haired man in his sixties, warm and direct, wearing a plain open-collar shirt and a sport jacket, stands on a college sideline with his hands on his hips, looking at a young player with concern, circa 1960s

storyboard.claim: As a college coach he had too much compassion for his players.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A coach on the sideline looking with concern at a player.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the Ivy League title.
storyboard.addedInformation: Compassion ended his football coaching career.

image.subject: A 1960s advertising agency creative office with drafting tables, layout boards pinned to the wall and a man in a suit pinning up a print layout, circa 1965

storyboard.claim: He moved into business, first to the ad agency J. Walter Thompson.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A 1960s ad agency office with layout boards.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Starts the career move.
storyboard.addedInformation: The first business job was in advertising.

storyboard.claim: He later sat in the boardrooms of Apple, Intuit and Google.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only: the company names.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the career path through Kodak.
storyboard.addedInformation: The career ends at the top technology boardrooms.

image.subject: A late-1990s Silicon Valley office loft with Herman Miller chairs, open desks and young engineers working at computers, a whiteboard on the wall

storyboard.claim: He walked into the sleek offices of the late 1990s tech boom.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A sleek loft office with Herman Miller chairs and engineers at computers.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Contrasts the grit with the sleek office.
storyboard.addedInformation: The office is the boom-era workplace.

image.subject: A stocky white-haired man in his sixties, warm and direct, wearing a plain open-collar shirt and a sport jacket, stands in a sleek open-plan office among young engineers in hoodies, looking around calmly, circa 1999

storyboard.claim: The grit of a steel town meets the boom-era tech culture.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Campbell in a sleek office surrounded by young engineers.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the office scene.
storyboard.addedInformation: His calm presence is the value he brings.

left.label: ERIC SCHMIDT
left.subject: A man in his fifties with short graying hair and a dark blazer over an open-collar shirt, measured and attentive, seated at a conference table, circa 2010

right.label: JONATHAN ROSENBERG
right.subject: A man in his fifties with short dark hair and a light blazer, engaged and conversational, seated at the same table in conversation, circa 2010

storyboard.claim: The authors, Eric Schmidt and Jonathan Rosenberg, document the story.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Two side-by-side portraits of the two authors.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Introduces the sources.
storyboard.addedInformation: The authors are former Google leaders.

image.subject: A pitch stage with a row of tech founders seated in front of a dark auditorium, a single spotlight on the empty center chair, circa 2010

storyboard.claim: The journey matters because of the caliber of people he coached.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A row of founders on a stage with an empty center chair.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Introduces the roster of coached people.
storyboard.addedInformation: The founders are seated on stage together.

image.subject: A slim man in his forties with a black mock turtleneck, jeans and sneakers, intense focused gaze, stands beside a young man in his late twenties with tousled brown hair and a casual sweater and a curly-haired young man in an open shirt, all three at a whiteboard in a bright office, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: He coached Steve Jobs, Larry Page and Sergey Brin.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Jobs, Page and Brin standing at a whiteboard together.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Starts the roster.
storyboard.addedInformation: Three of the coached founders are shown together.

storyboard.claim: The roster also includes Sundar Pichai and Sheryl Sandberg.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only: the list of names.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Continues the roster.
storyboard.addedInformation: Pichai and Sandberg are among the people he coached.

image.subject: Four executives in a glass-walled conference room, one with his head in his hands while the others argue across the table, papers scattered, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: He saved executive teams from ripping themselves apart under hypergrowth.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Executives arguing at a table, one with his head in his hands.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the roster with the stakes.
storyboard.addedInformation: The team is in conflict and close to breaking.

image.subject: A stocky white-haired man in his sixties, warm and direct, wearing a plain open-collar shirt and a sport jacket, stands in a boardroom holding a football on the table, the posture of a football coach, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: He applied the team-first mentality of the gridiron to the boardroom.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Campbell in a boardroom with a football on the table.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Explains how the team mentality moved from football.
storyboard.addedInformation: The football is the object that carries his past.

image.subject: An open notebook on a conference table with a whiteboard behind it, the page covered in a numbered list of handwritten points, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: Now the playbook begins, at the structural foundation.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An open notebook with numbered handwritten points.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Transitions to the playbook.
storyboard.addedInformation: The playbook is written notes, not a theory.

image.subject: A woman in her thirties with shoulder-length brown hair and a cardigan, sitting across a desk from a colleague in a glass-walled office, the two reviewing a document together, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: The people in charge of the environment are the managers.
storyboard.concreteVisual: A manager reviewing a document across the desk from a colleague.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves to the people in charge.
storyboard.addedInformation: The manager is the person who holds the environment together.

storyboard.claim: Why do managers need to exist at all?
storyboard.concreteVisual: Text only: the question.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Follows the manager scene with a question.
storyboard.addedInformation: The question frames the disdain for management.

image.subject: A young engineer at a crowded desk in a noisy open-plan office glances up with irritation at a manager walking by with a clipboard, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: In engineering fields management is seen as a disease.
storyboard.concreteVisual: An engineer irritated by a manager walking past.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Answers the question with the disdain.
storyboard.addedInformation: The engineer views the manager as friction.

image.subject: Larry Page and Sergey Brin in their early offices, walking down a hallway lined with desks and computers, a young man in his late twenties with tousled brown hair and a casual sweater on one side and a curly-haired young man in an open shirt on the other, circa 2001

storyboard.claim: The founders run the early Google offices.
storyboard.concreteVisual: Page and Brin walking down a hallway of early offices.
storyboard.relationToPrevious: Moves into the setting of the Google example.
storyboard.addedInformation: The founders run the place in 2001.
